description: This file implements the KeyIdMap class, which manages a thread-safe mapping between session IDs and key IDs, providing methods to add, update, retrieve, and erase key IDs associated with session IDs.

classes.name: KeyIdMap
classes.description: A singleton class that manages a thread-safe map of session IDs to key IDs.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns a reference to the singleton instance of KeyIdMap.

methods.name: addSession
methods.description: Adds a new session with the given session ID, initializing its key ID to an empty vector.

methods.name: updateKey
methods.description: Updates the key ID associated with a given session ID. Returns true if successful, false if the session ID does not exist.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the key ID associated with a given session ID. Returns an empty vector if the session ID is not found.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Removes the session ID and its associated key ID from the map.

search-terms: session ID to key ID mapping
